answer_1.quote: We test eight state-of-the-art chat-optimized LLMs on four different tasks requiring different levels of temporal and/or geographical knowledge

answer_2.quote: We use a custom matching algorithm based on regex patterns to extract the time and date from the model responses

answer_4.quote: We ask two independent annotators to evaluate a sample of 3,600 model responses for their correctness (true / false) compared to the gold answers
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judged correctness of the model's response against the gold answer, with specific attention to ensuring the response matched the correct time at the respective location
